test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a grammatical error. Select the option that has the error.

You can take a horse to the water but you cannot make it to drink.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the phrase 'make it to drink' is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be **'make it drink'** without the preposition** 'to'.**
 
 
• Example :** ***​I am unable **to make you understand **the matter since past 2 years.*
 
 

Therefore, The corrected sentence should read: ***You can take a horse to the water but you cannot make it drink**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is important to ensure that the*** verb forms are correctly used in phrases to maintain grammatical accuracy***.
 
• In English, c***ertain verbs do not require prepositions when followed by an object and an infinitive. For example, 'make' is one such verb.***
 
• Always ***review the structure of sentences to ensure that prepositions are used only when necessary.***
